share.protections: Choices for how a share is locked.
share.protections.key: The share is locked with a random key that is made for it.
share.protections.passphrase: The share is locked with a phrase the user chooses.
share.deliveries: Choices for how the share is handed over.
share.deliveries.link: The share becomes a web address.
share.privacy: Reassurance shown under the summary. Encryption happens on this device.
share.summaryWithValues: {{counts}} is a list like "3 requests, 1 folder and 2 environments".
share.summaryNamesOnly: Variables are listed by name only; their values are left out.
share.tooLong: {{size}} and {{limit}} are sizes such as 12.4 KB.
share.linkNotePassphrase: {{size}} is the length of the link, for example 3.1 KB. Keep the sentence structure: the size is printed at the end.
share.linkNoteKey: The # sign separates the address from the key. {{size}} is the length of the link.
share.linkLabel: Accessible label of the field that holds the link.
share.saveFile: Button that saves the encrypted file.
share.keyLabel: Label of the field that shows the key.
share.scopeField: Label of the choice of what to share.
share.requestScope: Option: only one request. {{path}} is the request with its folders.
share.sharedVariables: {{names}} is a comma separated list of variable names.
share.sharedCollectionVariables: {{names}} is a comma separated list of variable names.
share.sendAs: Label of the choice between link and file.
share.literalCredentials: Warning: secrets typed directly into a request are part of the request and are shared.
shareOpen.title: Title of the dialog that opens when someone shares a collection with the user.
shareOpen.environmentNoValues: One line per environment. {{name}} is the environment, a named set of variables.
shareOpen.environmentValues: {{values}} is how many of the variables carry a value.
shareOpen.folders: {{names}} is a comma separated list of folder names.
shareOpen.keepValues: On import, variables the user already has are not overwritten.
shareOpen.activeContent: {{kinds}} lists things that run code, for example scripts and OAuth settings.
shareOpen.requestsLabel: Heading above the list of shared requests.
shareOpen.deriving: Progress text: a key is computed from the passphrase, which takes a moment.
shareErrors.unavailable: Web Crypto API is a browser feature name.
shareErrors.cannotDecompress: Shown when the shared data is compressed with a method this browser lacks.
shareErrors.failedLink: Shown when a link without a key could not be decrypted.
shareErrors.unknownVersion: {{version}} is a format identifier and stays unchanged.
shareOpen.credentials.key.label: Label of an API key found in a shared item.
